## Ctx.renderLocation() method

Sends a location using the page template.

Template block: `<g-media>` (read via `renderMedia`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderLocation(keyboard?: IInBoKb | null, data?: IData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: IOptReplyLocation | null): Promise<unknown>;
```

The sent message object.

## Remarks

When the template `<g-media type="location">` carries a `live` attribute (seconds), it is validated by `Ctx.assertLivePeriod` and sent as Bot API `live_period`<!-- -->. Stop it later with [Ctx.stopLiveLocation()](./gramstax.ctx.stoplivelocation.md)<!-- -->.

  await this.renderLocation()
